# hivelocity_vlan (Resource)

Manages a VLAN in a facility and the device ports (or bonds) and IP assignments attached to it. Port and IP changes are applied asynchronously by the network automation; the provider waits for the resulting task to finish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_bare_metal_device" "webserver" {
  product_id    = 525
  os_name       = "Ubuntu 22.04"
  location_name = "TPA2"
  hostname      = "webserver.terraform.test"
}

resource "hivelocity_bare_metal_device" "database" {
  product_id    = 525
  os_name       = "Ubuntu 22.04"
  location_name = "TPA2"
  hostname      = "database.terraform.test"
}

data "hivelocity_device_port" "webserver_private_port" {
  first     = true
  device_id = hivelocity_bare_metal_device.webserver.device_id
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["eth1"]
  }
}

data "hivelocity_device_port" "database_private_port" {
  first     = true
  device_id = hivelocity_bare_metal_device.database.device_id
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["eth1"]
  }
}

resource "hivelocity_vlan" "private_vlan" {
  facility_code = "TPA2"
  type          = "private"
  port_ids = [
    data.hivelocity_device_port.webserver_private_port.port_id,
    data.hivelocity_device_port.database_private_port.port_id,
  ]
}

output "vlan_tag" {
  value = hivelocity_vlan.private_vlan.vlan_tag
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `facility_code` (String) Facility where the VLAN is created, for example `NYC1`. Only devices from the same facility can be attached.
- `type` (String) `public` VLANs can have IP assignments routed to them and be reachable from the internet. `private` VLANs never carry public IPs. All VLAN traffic is subject to bandwidth billing except private VLAN traffic on unbonded devices.

### Optional

- `ip_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of IP assignments routed to this VLAN (public VLANs only).
- `port_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of device ports or bonds to include in this VLAN.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `automated` (Boolean) True when the VLAN can be automated through the API. If false, contact support to enable automation.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `q_in_q` (Boolean) True when the VLAN is configured in Q-in-Q mode. Automation is not supported on Q-in-Q VLANs.
- `tag_id` (Number, Deprecated) Alias of `vlan_tag`, kept for backwards compatibility.
- `vlan_tag` (Number) The VLAN tag from the switch. Use this value when configuring your OS interfaces.
